_comment: §6.N bluff-hunt of PRE-EXISTING tests (NOT authored this session) across 5 distinct modules + architectural layers. Per Seventh Law clause 5 + §6.N protocol: for each target the EXACT production code path the test claims to cover was deliberately MUTATED, ONLY the scoped single test was run (no device/emulator, no full build), the verbatim FAIL captured, then the mutation reverted via `git checkout --` and the scoped test re-run to confirm GREEN. All mutations reverted; git status clean of production-file mutations at end. No bluffs found.
cycle: post-1076 device-gate-repair cycle (§6.AK), bluff-hunt of pre-existing tests
constraints: scoped single-module JVM/Go unit tests only; NO :app:connectedAndroidTest, NO emulator/device, NO full-project build, NO git add/commit/push

targets.claims_to_cover: size-string -> byte conversion (binary 1024 multipliers); LVA-027 regression where Kinozal rows dropped their size
targets.observed_failure_verbatim: java.lang.AssertionError: expected:<1610612736> but was:<1500000000>  (at KinozalSizeParserTest.kt:22 `parses comma-decimal`; same failure on `parses Latin GB to binary bytes` and the end-to-end `search row carries sizeBytes end to end`). 5 tests completed, 4 failed.

targets.layer: model mapper (core, pure-Kotlin; lava-api-go /jackett/search JSON -> SDK SearchResult)
targets.claims_to_cover: 1-based route page -> 0-based SDK currentPage conversion (`currentPage = dto.page - 1`)
targets.observed_failure_verbatim: java.lang.AssertionError: page 1 (1-based) becomes 0 (0-based) expected:<0> but was:<1>  (at JackettResultMapperTest.kt:41; the page-2 test fails the same way expected:<1> but was:<2>). 3 tests completed, 2 failed.

targets.claims_to_cover: enqueue stamps a real monotonic wall-clock createdAt so the DAO's `ORDER BY createdAt ASC` FIFO replay is meaningful
targets.observed_failure_verbatim: SyncOutboxImplTest > enqueue stamps real createdAt and observe replays in FIFO order FAILED ;; java.lang.AssertionError at SyncOutboxImplTest.kt:84 (the non-zero-createdAt assertTrue at lines 100-104: 'every enqueued row MUST carry a real (non-zero) createdAt timestamp' fires because both rows carried createdAt==0 < before). 3 tests completed, 1 failed.
targets.verbatim_capture_note: The assertTrue message string was not in the captured stdout tail (truncated to the AssertionError + source line); the report html was overwritten by the green revert re-run, so only the FAILED line + source location were captured verbatim. The failing assertion is identified by source line, not fabricated.

targets.claims_to_cover: trusted-proxy X-Forwarded-For unwrap: when RemoteAddr is in the trusted-CIDR set, the XFF client IP is used as the ladder lookup key (so a blocked client behind a trusted proxy still gets 429)
targets.mutation: in resolveClientIP, inside the trusted-CIDR branch, replaced `first := strings.SplitN(xff,",",2)[0]; return strings.TrimSpace(first)` with `_ = strings.SplitN(xff,",",2)[0]; return remote` (ignore the XFF, return the proxy's own IP)
targets.observed_failure_verbatim: backoff_test.go:83: status = 200, want 429 (trusted proxy XFF unwrap failed) ;; --- FAIL: TestBackoffMiddleware_BlockedHonorsTrustedProxy_XForwardedFor (0.00s). The untrusted-proxy test stayed PASS (mutation localized to the trusted branch).

targets.claims_to_cover: observed AuthState is reduced into rendered VM state (account screen shows the authorized identity; logout flips render to Unauthorized)
targets.mutation: in observeAuthState(), removed `reduce { authState }` inside collectLatest (observe the flow but never re-render)
targets.observed_failure_verbatim: AccountViewModelTest > ConfirmLogoutClick logs out and clears local data FAILED ;; app.cash.turbine.TurbineAssertionError at channel.kt:89 / Caused by: app.cash.turbine.TurbineTimeoutCancellationException at channel.kt:123 (the `observed Authorized auth state is rendered` test fails the same way — the Authorized/Unauthorized re-render never emits so awaitState() times out, exactly as the test KDoc's documented rehearsal predicts). 4 tests completed, 2 failed. The two SideEffect-only tests (LoginClick/LogoutClick) stayed PASS — mutation localized to the state-render path.
